2つ以上のエコーから水画像・脂肪画像・同位相・逆位相を一度に作る。磁場不均一に強: Produces water, fat, in-phase and opposed-phase images at once from two or more echoes. Uniform fat suppression robust to field inhomogeneity.
2つ以上のフリップ角の3D GREからT1を推定。B1の誤差に敏感。: Estimates T1 from 3D GRE at two or more flip angles. Sensitive to B1 errors.
2回の反転で髄液と白質を抑制し、皮質・病変を強調。皮質病変の検出に用いる。: Two inversions suppress CSF and white matter, emphasizing cortex and lesions. Used to detect cortical lesions.
2次元選択励起で関心領域だけを励起し、位相方向のFOVを狭めても折り返さない。前: 2D selective excitation excites only the region of interest, so the phase FOV can be reduced without wrap-around. High resolution and low distortion for prostate, spinal cord, pancreas, etc.
3D GREの強度と位相を組み合わせ、静脈・微小出血・石灰化・鉄沈着を強調。位相: Combines 3D GRE magnitude and phase to emphasize veins, microbleeds, calcification and iron deposition. The sign convention of phase differs by scanner and should be checked.

3Dのスライス方向エンコード数。撮像時間に比例。: Number of encoding steps in the 3D slice direction. Scan time is proportional.
3Dのスラブ端の折り返し対策。: Prevents wrap-around at the 3D slab edges.
40〜80 mm の厚いスライスを1回のシングルショットで撮る投影像。: Projection image of a 40–80 mm thick slab acquired in a single shot.
6エコー程度のGREで脂肪分率（PDFF）とR2*を同時に推定。脂肪肝・鉄過剰の: Multi-echo GRE (about 6 echoes) estimates fat fraction (PDFF) and R2* simultaneously. Quantification of fatty liver and iron overload.
90°励起と180°再収束で作るスピンエコー。短TR・短TEでT1強調。撮像時間: Spin echo formed by a 90° excitation and 180° refocusing. Short TR and short TE give T1 weighting. Scan time = TR × phase-encoding steps × averages.

<p>仮想ファントムは解析的な図形で描いた 1024² のラベル地図で、各組織に: The virtual phantom is a 1024² label map drawn with analytic shapes; each tissue is assigned T1, T2, T2*, proton density, ADC, fat fraction, susceptibility, flow velocity and other properties. The complex signal of each tissue is computed with sequence-specific signal equations (SE, FSE, IR, spoiled GRE, bSSFP steady state, FISP/PSIF, numerical simulation of MPRAGE/MP2RAGE, diffusion, inflow, phase contrast, etc.), sampled to the FOV (including wrap-around in the phase-encoding direction), transformed to k-space with a 2D FFT, and returned to image space after applying the acquisition matrix, partial Fourier, T2 decay along the echo train, and phase errors from respiratory and pulsatile motion. Shifts from chemical shift and susceptibility in the readout direction (phase-encoding direction for EPI), intravoxel dephasing in GRE, failure of frequency-selective fat suppression, B1 inhomogeneity at 3T, surface coil sensitivity variation, and parallel imaging g-factor and noise are also added.

FISP と PSIF のエコーを1回で収集し合成。膝軟骨の3D評価に用いる。: Acquires and combines FISP and PSIF echoes in one sequence. Used for 3D evaluation of knee cartilage.
FSEではSEより脂肪が明るく見えやすい（J結合の影響が弱まるため）。脂肪抑制で: Fat appears brighter on FSE than on SE (J-coupling effects are reduced). Confirm with fat suppression.
FSEのエコー位置をずらして水・脂肪を分離。T2強調でも均一な脂肪抑制が得られる: Shifts FSE echo positions to separate water and fat. Provides uniform fat suppression even on T2-weighted images.
FSEのエコー間隔。短いほどぼけが少ない。最短値はバンド幅で決まる。: FSE echo spacing. Shorter spacing means less blurring. The minimum is set by the bandwidth.
GREでは磁場の不均一による位相のずれが戻らないので、T2*で信号が減る。: In GRE, dephasing from field inhomogeneity is not refocused, so signal decreases with T2*.
GREは180°パルスがないので、磁場の不均一（T2*）の影響を受ける。: GRE has no 180° pulse, so it is affected by field inhomogeneity (T2*).

MTパルスで脳実質を抑えると血管が目立つ。: Suppressing brain parenchyma with an MT pulse makes vessels more conspicuous.
PLD が短く、標識血が組織に届く前に撮像されるため血管内に信号が残ります（動脈: PLD is short, so imaging occurs before labeled blood reaches tissue and signal remains in vessels (arterial transit artifact)

T2*強調EPIを連続撮像し、課題で増える酸素化Hb（デオキシHbの減少）による: Continuous T2*-weighted EPI detects signal increases from task-related rises in oxygenated Hb (decreased deoxyHb).
T2/T1の大きい血液・液体が明るく、心筋は暗い。: Blood and fluid with a high T2/T1 are bright; myocardium is dark.
TE を極短にできる。3D では球状に埋める: Enables ultrashort TE. In 3D, k-space is filled spherically
TEを延ばすとT2強調寄りになり、液体と軟骨のコントラストが変わる。: Lengthening TE shifts toward T2 weighting and changes the contrast between fluid and cartilage.
TEを延ばすと、出血・鉄沈着などT2*の短いものが黒く強調されることを確かめる。: Confirm that lengthening TE makes short-T2* materials such as hemorrhage and iron deposition darker.
TEを延ばすと全体の信号が下がり、T2の長い液体だけが残る。: Lengthening TE lowers overall signal, leaving only long-T2 fluid.
TEを延ばすと嚢胞・血管腫などT2の長いものだけが明るく残る（重いT2強調）。: Lengthening TE leaves only long-T2 lesions such as cysts and hemangiomas bright (heavily T2-weighted).
TEを延ばすほど、急性期血腫・ヘモジデリンなど磁化率の大きいものが低信号になり、: The longer the TE, the darker materials with large susceptibility (acute hematoma, hemosiderin) become, appearing larger than they are (blooming).
TEを延ばすほど位相の差が大きくなり、静脈・出血が強調される。: The longer the TE, the larger the phase differences, and the more veins and hemorrhage are emphasized.
TIで髄液の信号をゼロにし、脳室周囲の病変を見やすくする仕組みを確かめる。: See how TI nulls the CSF signal, making periventricular lesions easier to see.
TIを変えると白質・灰白質・髄液の明るさの順番や差が変わる。: Changing TI changes the order and differences in brightness of white matter, gray matter and CSF.
TRが短いと髄液が回復しきらず、最適なTIも変わる。: With a short TR, CSF does not fully recover and the optimal TI also changes.
TRとTEの組み合わせでT1強調・プロトン密度強調・T2強調が決まることを確かめ: See how the combination of TR and TE determines T1, proton density or T2 weighting.
TRを延ばすと、磁場の不均一による帯状のアーチファクト（バンディング）が出やすい: Lengthening TR makes band-like artifacts from field inhomogeneity (banding) more likely.
TRを短く・フリップ角を大きくすると静止組織はより飽和して暗くなるが、遅い流れの: Shortening TR and increasing flip angle saturate and darken stationary tissue further, but slow-flowing blood also saturates more easily.
TRを短く（400–600 ms）すると、T1の短い組織（白質・脂肪）ほど回復が: With a short TR (400–600 ms), tissues with shorter T1 (white matter, fat) recover faster and appear brighter = T1 weighting.
TRを長くすると縦磁化がほぼ回復し、T1の差が消える。TEを短く保てばプロトン密: Lengthening TR allows near-complete longitudinal recovery, eliminating T1 differences. Keep TE short for proton density weighting; lengthen TE for T2 weighting.

b値が大きいほど水分子の動きによる信号低下が強くなる。ADCの低い組織ほど信号が: The higher the b-value, the greater the signal loss from water motion. Tissues with lower ADC retain more signal.
b値を上げると、拡散が制限された組織（急性期梗塞など）が明るく残ることを確かめる: Confirm that raising the b-value leaves tissue with restricted diffusion (such as acute infarction) bright.

位相方向にFOVを広げて折り返しを防ぐ（時間は増える）。: Extends the FOV in the phase direction to prevent wrap-around (increases scan time).
位相方向の撮像範囲（矩形FOV）。体の幅より小さいと折り返しが出る。: Phase-direction FOV (rectangular FOV). Wrap-around appears if it is smaller than the body width.
信号はフリップ角に対して山形になり、最大になる角度（エルンスト角）は TR/T1: Signal versus flip angle forms a peak; the angle of maximum signal (Ernst angle) is determined by TR/T1.
全身の仮想ファントムで、撮像条件を変えたときの画像と撮像時間・SNR・SAR の: An educational simulator that uses a whole-body virtual phantom to show how changing imaging parameters affects the image, scan time, SNR and SAR.
全軸の傾斜磁場を釣り合わせた定常状態。信号は T2/T1 比で決まり、血液・液体: Steady state with gradients balanced on all axes. Signal depends on T2/T1; blood and fluid are bright. Field inhomogeneity causes band-like artifacts (banding).
分割収集（スライスがTRに入らない）: Concatenations (slices do not fit in one TR)
前庭神経鞘腫（右・内耳道〜小脳橋角）: Vestibular schwannoma (right, internal auditory canal to cerebellopontine angle)
動脈相では肝細胞癌が濃染し、門脈相・平衡相で周囲より低くなる（washout）。: Hepatocellular carcinoma enhances avidly in the arterial phase and becomes hypointense to surrounding liver in the portal venous and equilibrium phases (washout).
双極傾斜磁場で流速を位相に変換。VENC を超える流速は位相が折り返す（エイリア: Bipolar gradients encode velocity into phase. Velocities exceeding VENC wrap around in phase (aliasing).
反転からの回復を符号付きで表示。T1の差を広いダイナミックレンジで見られる。: Displays inversion recovery with sign preserved. T1 differences can be viewed over a wide dynamic range.
反転パルスで準備した3D GREで、灰白質と白質のコントラストがTIで変わること: See how the gray-white matter contrast of inversion-prepared 3D GRE changes with TI.
反転パルスで準備した高速3D GRE。灰白質と白質のコントラストが高く、脳容積計: Inversion-prepared fast 3D GRE. High gray-white matter contrast; the standard for brain volumetry.
反転パルス後、脂肪の縦磁化がゼロになる時刻（TI）で読み出し脂肪を抑制。磁場不均: After an inversion pulse, readout at the time (TI) when fat longitudinal magnetization is zero suppresses fat. Robust to field inhomogeneity, but short-T1 tissues (e.g., enhancing lesions) are also suppressed.
反転後、T1の長い髄液の縦磁化がゼロを通る時刻（TI）で読み出すと髄液が黒くなる: After inversion, reading out at the time (TI) when the longitudinal magnetization of long-T1 CSF crosses zero makes CSF dark.
反転後の回復の途中で読み出すので、T1の差が大きく出る。: Readout occurs during recovery from inversion, so T1 differences are amplified.
反転時間。脂肪の null は 1.5T で約150–170 ms、3T で約: Inversion time. Fat is nulled at about 150–170 ms at 1.5T and about 200–230 ms at 3T (depends on TR).
受信帯域を広げ、VAT（view angle tilting）で面内のずれを、S: Widens receiver bandwidth and corrects in-plane shifts with VAT (view angle tilting) and through-plane shifts with SEMAC.
可変リフォーカス角で非常に長いエコートレインを使う等方性3D撮像。任意断面再構成: Isotropic 3D imaging with very long echo trains using variable refocusing angles. Allows multiplanar reformatting. Displayed TE is the "T2-equivalent TE".
各組織の画素の中央値。相対信号は最大を 100 とした値。推定SNRは中央値÷雑: Median pixel value of each tissue. Relative signal is scaled so that the maximum is 100. Estimated SNR is the median divided by the noise standard deviation and does not account for surface-coil sensitivity correction or spatial variation of the parallel-imaging g-factor. "vs. previous" compares with the same image under the immediately preceding settings.
名称を確認できていない。名称はソフトウェアのバージョン・地域で異なることがありま: name not verified. Names may differ by software version and region. Check against the protocol names on your own scanners.
変えたパラメータに横軸を合わせる: Match the x-axis to the changed parameter
外部の加振装置で肝に剪断波を伝え、波の長さから硬さ（kPa）を求める。線維化の評: An external driver transmits shear waves into the liver; stiffness (kPa) is derived from the wavelength. Assessment of fibrosis.
多エコーGREからT2*（R2*）を推定。鉄沈着の評価。空気との境界ではT2*が: Estimates T2* (R2*) from multi-echo GRE. Assessment of iron deposition. T2* appears short at air interfaces.
多方向の拡散強調像から異方性（FA）と平均拡散能を計算。神経線維の走行評価。: Calculates anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity from diffusion-weighted images in multiple directions. Assessment of white matter tract orientation.
実効TEがエコートレインより長いため、TE=: Effective TE is longer than the echo train; corrected to TE=
実効TEでT2コントラストが決まり、ETLで撮像時間とぼけが変わることを確かめる: See how effective TE determines T2 contrast and ETL changes scan time and blurring.
実効TE（k空間中心のエコー時刻）でT2の重みが決まる。浮腫・液体はTEを延ばし: Effective TE (echo time at the k-space center) determines T2 weighting. Edema and fluid stay bright even when TE is lengthened.
実質臓器の辺縁はぼけやすい。: Margins of solid organs tend to blur.
小FOV励起：位相方向のFOV外は励起されないため折り返しません: Small-FOV excitation: tissue outside the phase FOV is not excited, so no wrap-around occurs
広いと化学シフト・磁化率による歪みが減り最短TE/ESPが短くなるが、SNRは√: A wider bandwidth reduces chemical shift and susceptibility distortion and shortens the minimum TE/ESP, but SNR drops with the square root.
弱（既定：外周を緩やかに減衰）: Low (default: gentle roll-off at the periphery)
心筋梗塞（LV心尖部〜前側壁・心内膜下）: Myocardial infarction (LV apex to anterolateral wall, subendocardial)
心電図同期セグメント収集の1心拍あたりのライン数。時間分解能=VPS×TR。: Lines per heartbeat in ECG-gated segmented acquisition. Temporal resolution = VPS × TR.
心電図同期・セグメント収集で心周期の動画を作る。時間分解能 = 1セグメントのラ: ECG-gated segmented acquisition produces a movie of the cardiac cycle. Temporal resolution = lines per segment × TR.
折り返し・動きのゴースト・化学シフトの向きが変わる: Changes the direction of wrap-around, motion ghosts and chemical shift
拡張期と収縮期の3D FSEを撮り、差分で動脈だけを残す。収縮期の速い動脈血は信: Acquires diastolic and systolic 3D FSE and subtracts them to leave only arteries. Fast systolic arterial blood shows signal void. Used in the lower limbs and abdomen.
拡散強調像の最短TEに影響: Affects the minimum TE of DWI
撮像範囲。大きくすると画素が大きくなりSNRは上がるが分解能は下がる。: Field of view. A larger FOV gives larger pixels and higher SNR but lower resolution.
撮像範囲に反転パルス（タグ）をかけ、BBTI の間に流入した未反転の動脈血だけを: Applies an inversion pulse (tag) to the imaging volume and depicts only non-inverted arterial blood that flows in during BBTI as bright. Used for renal arteries and similar.
放射状にk空間を埋めるため呼吸の影響が分散し、自由呼吸で撮像できる。撮像時間はや: Radial k-space filling disperses respiratory effects, allowing free-breathing acquisition. Scan time is somewhat longer.
既定値から変えたパラメータの数: Number of parameters changed from defaults
最短値より短い TE・TR・エコー間隔は計算時に補正し、数値を黄色で示します。範: TE, TR and echo spacing shorter than the minimum are corrected during calculation, and the values are shown in yellow. Ranges are wider than scanner limits and include values that cannot be set on real scanners.
枚、図には出ない）: slices simultaneously; not shown in diagram)
棘上筋腱 全層断裂（大結節付着部近傍）: Full-thickness supraspinatus tendon tear (near greater tuberosity insertion)
標識終了から撮像までの時間。: Time from the end of labeling to imaging.
横磁化を残す定常状態GRE。T2/T1 比とT1の混合コントラスト。: Steady-state GRE that retains transverse magnetization. Mixed T2/T1 and T1 contrast.
横軸をTEにしたグラフで、脂肪を含む組織の信号が周期的に上下する様子を確かめる。: On the graph with TE on the horizontal axis, see how the signal of fat-containing tissue oscillates periodically.
水と脂肪が逆位相・同位相になるTEで撮像。少量の脂肪（脂肪肝・副腎腺腫）を逆位相: Images at TEs where water and fat are opposed and in phase. Small amounts of fat (fatty liver, adrenal adenoma) are detected as signal loss on opposed-phase images.
水と脂肪の位相がそろう／逆になるTEで、少量の脂肪を検出する原理を確かめる。: See the principle of detecting small amounts of fat using TEs at which water and fat are in phase or opposed phase.
水と脂肪は共鳴周波数がわずかに違い、TEによって位相がそろったり逆になったりする: Water and fat have slightly different resonance frequencies, so they move in and out of phase with TE (alternating opposed/in phase about every 2.3 ms at 1.5T).
流れる血液が無信号になる（ブラックブラッド）。血管壁・転移の検出に。: Flowing blood shows signal void (black blood). For vessel walls and metastasis detection.
流入する未飽和の血液が明るく、静止組織は繰り返しパルスで飽和して暗い。面内を流れ: Inflowing unsaturated blood is bright, while stationary tissue is saturated and dark from repeated pulses. In-plane vessels and slow flow saturate and are poorly seen.
流入する未飽和の血液が明るく、静止組織は飽和して暗くなるTOFの原理を確かめる。: See the TOF principle: inflowing unsaturated blood is bright and stationary tissue is saturated and dark.
浸潤性乳癌（左乳房・外側、スピキュラ）: Invasive breast cancer (left breast, lateral, spiculated)
画像上にカーソルを置くと、組織名・信号・T1/T2 を表示します。: Hover over the image to show tissue name, signal and T1/T2.
短TR・短ETLのFSE。SE T1より速いが、ETLを伸ばすとT1コントラスト: FSE with short TR and short ETL. Faster than SE T1, but lengthening ETL weakens T1 contrast.
磁場の不均一が大きい部位で水・脂肪の入れ替わり（swap）が起きています: Water-fat swap is occurring in regions with large field inhomogeneity
磁場の不均一に強く、広い範囲で均一に脂肪が抑えられる。: Robust to field inhomogeneity, giving uniform fat suppression over a wide area.
磁場不均一に弱いのは CHESS・SPAIR・水選択励起。STIR と Dixo: CHESS, SPAIR and water excitation are sensitive to field inhomogeneity. STIR and Dixon are robust to it but work on different principles
等方性の3D FLAIR。多発性硬化症などで標準的。: Isotropic 3D FLAIR. Standard for multiple sclerosis and similar conditions.
組織値は文献値を丸めた代表値または推定値で、仮想ファントムは解析的な図形で描いた: Tissue values are rounded representative literature values or estimates, and the virtual phantom is a schematic drawn with analytic shapes. It does not reproduce patient images, diagnostic thresholds or scanner-displayed values (scan time, SAR). Vendor names are shown with a confidence level.
線＝ジグザグの軌跡、色＝取得順。中心（▶）が TE: Line = zigzag trajectory, color = acquisition order. Center (▶) = TE
肝細胞癌（右葉後区・被膜あり）: Hepatocellular carcinoma (right posterior section, with capsule)
背景抑制拡散強調像（DWIBS）: Diffusion-weighted whole-body imaging with background suppression (DWIBS)
脂肪のT1は短いので、反転後早い時刻（1.5Tで約150–170 ms）にゼロに: Fat has a short T1, so it reaches zero early after inversion (about 150–170 ms at 1.5T).
脂肪の縦磁化がゼロになるTIで脂肪を抑え、浮腫を目立たせる仕組みを確かめる。: See how fat is suppressed at the TI where its longitudinal magnetization is zero, making edema stand out.
脂肪・亜急性期血腫などT1の短いものも明るく見えるので注意。: Note that short-T1 materials such as fat and subacute hematoma also appear bright.
脂肪抑制3D GREのダイナミック造影で、時相ごとに病変の見え方が変わることを確: See how lesion appearance changes with each phase of dynamic contrast-enhanced fat-suppressed 3D GRE.
脂肪抑制を入れると骨髄浮腫・関節液が目立つ。CHESS／SPAIRは磁場不均一に: Adding fat suppression makes bone marrow edema and joint fluid stand out. CHESS/SPAIR are sensitive to field inhomogeneity.
脳の容積計測では、条件を固定して比べることが大切。: For brain volumetry, it is important to compare with fixed parameters.
腎細胞癌（左腎・淡明細胞型）: Renal cell carcinoma (left kidney, clear cell)
腹部ダイナミック・造影の標準。息止めで薄いスライスの3D T1。: Standard for abdominal dynamic contrast-enhanced imaging. Breath-hold thin-slice 3D T1.
色＝エコー番号（黄＝早い→紫＝遅い）。中心（▶）のエコーが実効TE: Color = echo number (yellow = early → purple = late). The center (▶) echo is the effective TE
色＝取得順（黄＝早い→紫＝遅い）。中心（▶）が TE: Color = acquisition order (yellow = early → purple = late). Center (▶) = TE
血管の流入側に飽和パルスを置き、拍動による位相方向のゴーストを減らす: Places a saturation pulse on the inflow side of vessels to reduce pulsatile ghosts in the phase direction
血管腫は辺縁から結節状に染まり、時間とともに内部へ広がる。: Hemangiomas show peripheral nodular enhancement that fills in centripetally over time.
血腫の病期を変えて見え方を比べる。: Compare the appearance across hematoma stages.
表面コイル由来の明るさのむらを補正（中心部の雑音は相対的に増える）: Corrects surface-coil intensity nonuniformity (noise in the center increases relatively)
複数のTEのSE画像からT2を推定。軟骨・心筋・肝で使う。: Estimates T2 from SE images at multiple TEs. Used for cartilage, myocardium and liver.
複数のTIの画像からT1を推定。MOLLIは真のT1よりやや短く出る傾向がある。: Estimates T1 from images at multiple TIs. MOLLI tends to slightly underestimate true T1.
複数スライスを同時に励起。TRを短く・時間短縮。: Excites multiple slices simultaneously. Shortens TR and scan time.
見出しを押すと開閉します: Click a heading to expand or collapse
読出し分割EPIのセグメント数。: Number of readout segments for readout-segmented EPI.
読出し方向に分割して収集し、エコー間隔を短くして歪み・ぼけを減らす。撮像時間は分: Acquires in segments along the readout direction, shortening echo spacing to reduce distortion and blurring. Scan time is proportional to the number of segments.
読出し方向の画素数。: Number of pixels in the readout direction.
逆位相では、脂肪と水が同じボクセルに混ざる組織（脂肪肝・副腎腺腫）の信号が下がる: On opposed-phase images, signal drops in tissues where fat and water are mixed in the same voxel (fatty liver, adrenal adenoma).
造影剤の初回循環で血液のT1を大きく短縮させ、短TRの3D GREで撮る。造影前: First-pass contrast greatly shortens blood T1, imaged with short-TR 3D GRE. The pre-contrast image is subtracted.
造影剤の初回循環で起こるT2*短縮から相対脳血液量を求める。: Derives relative cerebral blood volume from T2* shortening during first pass of contrast.
造影後10分前後に、正常心筋がゼロになるTIで撮像。瘢痕・線維化が高信号。PSI: Imaged about 10 minutes after contrast at the TI that nulls normal myocardium. Scar and fibrosis are hyperintense. PSIR is robust to TI errors.
長TR・短TEでT1とT2の影響を減らし、水素密度の差を見る。: Long TR and short TE reduce T1 and T2 effects to show differences in proton density.
長TR・短TEで水素密度の差を見る。半月板・腱はT2が非常に短く低信号。: Long TR and short TE show differences in proton density. Menisci and tendons have very short T2 and are hypointense.
長いTE・小さいフリップ角でT2*を強調。出血・石灰化・鉄沈着を低信号で示す。: Long TE and low flip angle emphasize T2*. Hemorrhage, calcification and iron deposition appear hypointense.
長いTIで髄液を抑制したT2強調像。TR が短いと髄液の抑制が不十分。: T2-weighted image with CSF suppressed by a long TI. Short TR leads to incomplete CSF suppression.
院内教育用 · 全身・網羅版（2026年11月） · 外部ライブラリを使わず、す: For in-house education · Whole-body comprehensive edition (November 2026) · Uses no external libraries; all calculations run within this file. The parameter simulator in the existing "MRI Sequence Primer" remains unchanged.
非常に長いTEで液体（胆汁・膵液）だけを残す。呼吸同期またはナビゲータで撮る。: Very long TE leaves only fluid (bile, pancreatic juice). Acquired with respiratory triggering or navigator.
面内飽和で背景を抑え、静止期に流入した動脈血をシングルショットbSSFPで撮る。: Suppresses background with in-plane saturation and images arterial blood that flows in during the quiescent interval with single-shot bSSFP. Lower-limb arteries.
面直交方向の歪みを補正（時間はステップ数に比例して延長）: Corrects through-plane distortion (time increases in proportion to the number of steps)
頭部（後頭蓋窩・内耳道レベル・軸位）: Head (posterior fossa, internal auditory canal level, axial)
頸部で血液を磁気的に標識し、標識あり・なしの差から脳血流（CBF）を求める。造影: Magnetically labels blood in the neck and derives cerebral blood flow (CBF) from the difference between labeled and control images. No contrast agent needed. With a short PLD, signal remains in vessels.
骨軟部で頻用。脂肪抑制併用で軟骨・半月板・骨髄浮腫を評価。: Widely used in musculoskeletal imaging. With fat suppression, evaluates cartilage, menisci and bone marrow edema.
骨軟部のプロトン密度強調と脂肪抑制で、軟骨・半月板・骨髄浮腫がどう見えるかを確か: See how cartilage, menisci and bone marrow edema appear on musculoskeletal proton density-weighted and fat-suppressed images.
骨髄浮腫（脛骨後方・骨挫傷）: Bone marrow edema (posterior tibia, bone contusion)
高b値だけ加算を増やす。: Adds extra averages for high b-values only.
高分子と結合した水の信号を下げる（白質・筋・軟骨が低下）: Reduces signal from macromolecule-bound water (white matter, muscle and cartilage darken)
